envelope.description: Add the draft hook and carry readiness through the result types

body.title: Add the draft hook and carry readiness through the result types
body.summary: Add ensureDraftIssues and IssueReadiness (not-applicable, ready, not-ready with outcomeKnown and the author's message; local-record fast path before loadTracker; Define, HLD, LLD and plan unit lists; Task issues forced; stop at the first failure). Call it right after the draft pair is written in synthesize.ts and in workflow-rpc.ts, and carry issueReadiness and notice on WorkflowStepDone, on RunWorkflowResult (return at line 352) and on the done frame (line 475).
acceptanceChecks: A Define, LLD or plan draft in team mode creates one issue per unit and a second write creates none and runs no command, even with sign-in lost.
An unreachable tracker leaves the draft files, returns not-ready with the reason, and a failed create is worded as unconfirmed, never as no issue.
The emitted workflow.run done frame, RunWorkflowResult and the step result all carry the fields for a team repo and none for a repo without a policy.
A re-draft keeps epicRef, storyRefs and the units, so sync, the chain report and Task approval still work.
